sentences.en: Okay, now I don't want to alarm anybody in this room, but it's just come to my attention that the person to your right is a liar.
sentences.zh: 我不想吓唬你们但是我发现坐在你右边的那个人是个骗子（众人笑）

sentences.en: (Laughter) Also, the person to your left is a liar.
sentences.zh: 坐在你左边的人也是个骗子

sentences.en: Also the person sitting in your very seats is a liar.
sentences.zh: 坐在你位置上的那个人还是个骗子

sentences.en: We're all liars. What I'm going to do today is I'm going to show you what the research says about why we're all liars, how you can become a liespotter and why you might want to go the extra mile and go from liespotting to truth seeking,
sentences.zh: 我们都是骗子今天我要讲的一项研究我们为什么是骗子如何识别谎言以及为什么要大费周折从识别谎言走向寻求真相

sentences.en: and ultimately to trust building. Now, speaking of trust, ever since I wrote this book, "Liespotting," no one wants to meet me in person anymore, no, no.
sentences.zh: 最终走到信任的建立说到信任自从我写了《识破谎言》之后谁都不愿意再和我面对面打交道了 没门

sentences.en: They say, "It's okay, we'll email you." (Laughter) I can't even get a coffee date at Starbucks.
sentences.zh: 大家都说："没关系，我们会给你发邮件的。"（众人笑）我甚至约不到人去星巴克喝咖啡

sentences.en: My husband's like, "Honey, deception? Maybe you could have focused on cooking. How about French cooking?"
sentences.zh: 我先生说：“亲爱的，测谎？你还是把心思花在烹饪上吧。学做法国菜，怎么样？”

sentences.en: So before I get started, what I'm going to do is I'm going to clarify my goal for you, which is not to teach a game of Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 切入主题之前我先澄清一下我演讲的目的不是叫你们玩测谎游戏

sentences.en: Liespotters aren't those nitpicky kids, those kids in the back of the room that are shouting, "Gotcha! Gotcha!
sentences.zh: 测谎者并不是专门挑刺的孩子那些孩子站在屋子后方大喊：“发现了！

sentences.en: Your eyebrow twitched. You flared your nostril.
sentences.zh: 你的眉毛动了。你的鼻孔动了。

sentences.en: I watch that TV show 'Lie To Me.' I know you're lying."
sentences.zh: 我看电视剧 “别对我撒谎”，我知道你在说谎。”

sentences.en: No, liespotters are armed with scientific knowledge of how to spot deception.
sentences.zh: 不 测谎者以识破谎言的科学知识来武装自己

sentences.en: They use it to get to the truth, and they do what mature leaders do everyday; they have difficult conversations with difficult people, sometimes during very difficult times.
sentences.zh: 找出真相他们像成熟的领导人那样工作与难以打交道的人进行艰难的对话有时候还碰上世态不济的时候

sentences.en: And they start up that path by accepting a core proposition, and that proposition is the following: Lying is a cooperative act.
sentences.zh: 他们踏上了这条道路怀着一项核心要点那就是说谎是一项协作行动

sentences.en: Think about it, a lie has no power whatsoever by its mere utterance.
sentences.zh: 谎言本身 没有丝毫力量

sentences.en: Its power emerges when someone else agrees to believe the lie.
sentences.zh: 而当人将谎言信以为真谎言的力量就产生了

sentences.en: So I know it may sound like tough love, but look, if at some point you got lied to, it's because you agreed to get lied to.
sentences.zh: 忠言逆耳但是 如果你被骗了那只能怪你相信了谎言

sentences.en: Truth number one about lying: Lying's a cooperative act.
sentences.zh: 关于说谎的第一条事实： 说谎是一项协作行动

sentences.en: Now not all lies are harmful. Sometimes we're willing participants in deception for the sake of social dignity, maybe to keep a secret that should be kept secret, secret.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有谎话都有害有时 为了保住社会尊严我们愿意说谎有些秘密还是不要道破为好

sentences.en: We say, "Nice song." "Honey, you don't look fat in that, no."
sentences.zh: 我们说：“这首歌真好听。”“亲爱的，你穿这件不显胖，一点也不。”

sentences.en: Or we say, favorite of the digiratti, "You know, I just fished that email out of my Spam folder.
sentences.zh: 我们还说"我才从垃圾邮件里看到那封邮件。

sentences.en: So sorry." But there are times when we are unwilling participants in deception.
sentences.zh: 真不好意思。”而有时候 我们不愿意参与说谎

sentences.en: And that can have dramatic costs for us.
sentences.zh: 而这时 我们可能会遭受重大损失

sentences.en: Last year saw 997 billion dollars in corporate fraud alone in the United States.
sentences.zh: 去年仅美国就因公司犯罪损失了9970亿美元

sentences.en: That's an eyelash under a trillion dollars.
sentences.zh: 这个数字差一点就到一万亿美元了

sentences.en: That's seven percent of revenues. Deception can cost billions.
sentences.zh: 占了总收入的7%欺诈可以造成数十亿美元的损失

sentences.en: Think Enron, Madoff, the mortgage crisis.
sentences.zh: 想想安然 麦道夫 次贷危机

sentences.en: Or in the case of double agents and traitors, like Robert Hanssen or Aldrich Ames, lies can betray our country, they can compromise our security, they can undermine democracy, they can cause the deaths of those that defend us.
sentences.zh: 还有像罗伯特·汉森和阿尔德里奇·埃姆斯等双面特工或叛徒谎言能够出卖我们的国家能够削弱安全保障 能够破坏民主制度能够夺走国家卫士的生命

sentences.en: Deception is actually serious business. This con man, Henry Oberlander, he was such an effective con man, British authorities say he could have undermined the entire banking system of the Western world.
sentences.zh: 欺骗是一个棘手的问题。这个骗子亨利·奥伯兰德他是个高明的骗子英国高官说他有能力破坏整个西方世界的银行体系你在谷歌上根本搜不到这个人 哪里都找不到

sentences.en: And you can't find this guy on Google; you can't find him anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他接受过一次采访 说了下面这些话

sentences.en: He was interviewed once, and he said the following.
sentences.zh: “ 我有一条守则。”

sentences.en: He said, "Look, I've got one rule." And this was Henry's rule, he said, "Look, everyone is willing to give you something.
sentences.zh: 这就是亨利的守则 他说“每个人都愿意给你某样东西。

sentences.en: They're ready to give you something for whatever it is they're hungry for."
sentences.zh: 只要是为了得到他们渴望的东西，他们就心甘情愿地拿东西来交换。”难就难在这里

sentences.en: And that's the crux of it. If you don't want to be deceived, you have to know, what is it that you're hungry for?
sentences.zh: 如果不想被骗 你就必须知道你渴望什么

sentences.en: And we all kind of hate to admit it. We wish we were better husbands, better wives, smarter, more powerful, taller, richer -- the list goes on.
sentences.zh: 我们都不愿承认我们希望自己能成为更好的丈夫 更好的妻子变得更聪明 更有权力更高 更富有诸如此类

sentences.en: Lying is an attempt to bridge that gap, to connect our wishes and our fantasies about who we wish we were, how we wish we could be, with what we're really like.
sentences.zh: 欺骗是人们试图在现实与愿望之间架起桥梁把我们理想中的自己与理想中的生活种种心愿和幻想与现实中的自己联系起来

sentences.en: And boy are we willing to fill in those gaps in our lives with lies.
sentences.zh: 天啊 难道我们要用谎言来填补现实与幻想之间的差距吗

sentences.en: On a given day, studies show that you may be lied to anywhere from 10 to 200 times.
sentences.zh: 研究表明 在每一天 你被欺骗的次数从10次到200次不等

sentences.en: Now granted, many of those are white lies.
sentences.zh: 的确 这其中有许多是善意的谎言

sentences.en: But in another study, it showed that strangers lied three times within the first 10 minutes of meeting each other.
sentences.zh: 而另一项研究显示陌生人见面后的前十分钟内说谎的次数为三次（众人笑）

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now when we first hear this data, we recoil.
sentences.zh: 头一次听到这个数据 我们不免心寒

sentences.en: We can't believe how prevalent lying is.
sentences.zh: 我们不敢相信人们说谎竟如此频繁

sentences.en: We're essentially against lying. But if you look more closely, the plot actually thickens.
sentences.zh: 我们本质上与说谎对立但如果你细看

sentences.en: We lie more to strangers than we lie to coworkers.
sentences.zh: 情况可没那么简单我们对陌生人说谎的次数比对同事说谎的次数要多

sentences.en: Extroverts lie more than introverts. Men lie eight times more about themselves than they do other people.
sentences.zh: 外向的人比内向的人说谎次数多男性关于自己的谎言比关于别人的谎言多出了八倍

sentences.en: Women lie more to protect other people. If you're an average married couple, you're going to lie to your spouse in one out of every 10 interactions.
sentences.zh: 女性说谎往往是为了保护他人如果你们是一对普通夫妻那么你对自己的配偶每交流10次就有一次在说谎

sentences.en: Now, you may think that's bad. If you're unmarried, that number drops to three.
sentences.zh: 你可能觉得这很不好如果你未婚 那么每交流3次就有一次在说谎

sentences.en: Lying's complex. It's woven into the fabric of our daily and our business lives.
sentences.zh: 说谎这事挺复杂的这跟我们的日常生活与工作交织在一起

sentences.en: We're deeply ambivalent about the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们对真相总是拿捏不准

sentences.en: We parse it out on an as-needed basis, sometimes for very good reasons, other times just because we don't understand the gaps in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们在需要的时候才来分析它有时候是情理之中的而有时候则是因为我们不理解生活中现实与理想的差距

sentences.en: That's truth number two about lying. We're against lying, but we're covertly for it in ways that our society has sanctioned for centuries and centuries and centuries.
sentences.zh: 这是关于说谎的第二条真相我们反对说谎但背地里赞同说谎我们的社会对种种这些做法包容了好几百年

sentences.en: It's as old as breathing. It's part of our culture, it's part of our history.
sentences.zh: 其历史源远流长是我们文化和历史的一部分

sentences.en: Think Dante, Shakespeare, the Bible, News of the World.
sentences.zh: 想想看但丁 莎士比亚圣经 世界新闻报

sentences.en: (Laughter) Lying has evolutionary value to us as a species.
sentences.zh: （众人笑）说谎在人类进化上有着重要价值

sentences.en: Researchers have long known that the more intelligent the species, the larger the neocortex, the more likely it is to be deceptive.
sentences.zh: 研究者早就知道物种的智慧越高大脑皮层越大这个物种就更可能欺骗

sentences.en: Now you might remember Koko. Does anybody remember Koko the gorilla who was taught sign language?
sentences.zh: 你们可能还记得可可有人还记得那只学会手语的大猩猩可可吗

sentences.en: Koko was taught to communicate via sign language.
sentences.zh: 可可学会如何用手语进行交流

sentences.en: Here's Koko with her kitten. It's her cute little, fluffy pet kitten.
sentences.zh: 这是可可和她的小猫这就是她毛茸茸的可爱小猫咪

sentences.en: Koko once blamed her pet kitten for ripping a sink out of the wall.
sentences.zh: 可可有一次责备她的小猫怪它把洗手池从墙上剥下来（众人笑）

sentences.en: (Laughter) We're hardwired to become leaders of the pack.
sentences.zh: 我们天生就喜欢做领导

sentences.en: It's starts really, really early. How early?
sentences.zh: 这从很早很早就开始了多早

sentences.en: Well babies will fake a cry, pause, wait to see who's coming and then go right back to crying.
sentences.zh: 婴儿就会假哭停一下 看看谁走过来接着哭

sentences.en: One-year-olds learn concealment. (Laughter) Two-year-olds bluff.
sentences.zh: 一岁的孩子就学会隐瞒事实了（众人笑）两岁的孩子就会吓唬人了

sentences.en: Five-year-olds lie outright. They manipulate via flattery.
sentences.zh: 五岁的孩子撒谎都可以不打草稿了他们通过巴结来达到目的

sentences.en: Nine-year-olds, masters of the cover-up.
sentences.zh: 九岁的孩子是掩盖真相的高手

sentences.en: By the time you enter college, you're going to lie to your mom in one out of every five interactions.
sentences.zh: 到你上大学的时候你与你母亲的每交流五次中就有一次是在说谎

sentences.en: By the time we enter this work world and we're breadwinners, we enter a world that is just cluttered with Spam, fake digital friends, partisan media, ingenious identity thieves, world-class Ponzi schemers,
sentences.zh: 到我们工作了 挣钱养家了我们便进入了一个充满了垃圾邮件 虚假身份的网友政党媒体身份盗用世界级的庞氏骗局一个谎言的流行病

sentences.en: a deception epidemic -- in short, what one author calls a post-truth society.
sentences.zh: 用一位作家的话简单地说这是一个后真相社会长时间以来

sentences.en: It's been very confusing for a long time now.
sentences.zh: 这一直在混淆视听怎么办呢

sentences.en: What do you do? Well, there are steps we can take to navigate our way through the morass.
sentences.zh: 有几个步骤可以指导我们走出迷雾受过识谎训练的人能认识到90%的真相

sentences.en: Trained liespotters get to the truth 90 percent of the time.
sentences.zh: 而普通人只有54%的正确率

sentences.en: The rest of us, we're only 54 percent accurate.
sentences.zh: 剩下的人 我们只有54%的准确度

sentences.en: Why is it so easy to learn? There are good liars and bad liars.
sentences.zh: 为什么人能轻易学会识破谎言呢骗子有高明的 也有蹩脚的 但没有绝对与众不同的骗子

sentences.en: There are no real original liars. We all make the same mistakes. We all use the same techniques.
sentences.zh: 我们都会犯同样的错误 采用同样的技巧我下面

sentences.en: So what I'm going to do is I'm going to show you two patterns of deception.
sentences.zh: 向你们展示两种欺骗的模式我们将看到一些破绽 看看我们能不能把它们找出来

sentences.en: And then we're going to look at the hot spots and see if we can find them ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们先看看演讲

sentences.en: We're going to start with speech. (Video) Bill Clinton: I want you to listen to me.
sentences.zh: （视频）克林顿总统：我想要你们听我说我再次重申

sentences.en: I'm going to say this again. I did not have sexual relations with that woman, Miss Lewinsky.
sentences.zh: 我与那个女人莱温斯基小姐 没有发生过性关系

sentences.en: I never told anybody to lie, not a single time, never.
sentences.zh: 我从未指示任何人说谎从来也没有

sentences.en: And these allegations are false. And I need to go back to work for the American people.
sentences.zh: 这些指控都是莫须有的我必须回去为美国人民工作了谢谢你们

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause) Pamela Meyer: Okay, what were the telltale signs?
sentences.zh: 好 破绽是哪些呢

sentences.en: Well first we heard what's known as a non-contracted denial.
sentences.zh: 首先 我们听到一个正式的否定形式

sentences.en: Studies show that people who are overdetermined in their denial will resort to formal rather than informal language.
sentences.zh: 研究表明 人们在过度强调否认时喜欢使用较为正式的语言

sentences.en: We also heard distancing language: "that woman."
sentences.zh: 我们还听到 “那个女人” 这种遥指性的措辞

sentences.en: We know that liars will unconsciously distance themselves from their subject, using language as their tool.
sentences.zh: 我们知道 骗子们会不经意地疏远话中的主语借用语言来达此目的

sentences.en: Now if Bill Clinton had said, "Well, to tell you the truth ..."
sentences.zh: 如果克林顿说的是：“哎，实话告诉你吧...”

sentences.en: or Richard Nixon's favorite, "In all candor ..."
sentences.zh: 或者用到尼克松总统的口头禅：“实话跟你说...”

sentences.en: he would have been a dead giveaway for any liespotter that knows that qualifying language, as it's called, qualifying language like that, further discredits the subject.
sentences.zh: 他立马就会在识谎者面前露出马脚因为识谎者知道这种被称为修饰语的话更能暴露谎言

sentences.en: Now if he had repeated the question in its entirety, or if he had peppered his account with a little too much detail -- and we're all really glad he didn't do that -- he would have further discredited himself.
sentences.zh: 如果他完整地将问题重复一遍或者他暴露过多细节幸好他没这么做那他的话就更不可信了

sentences.en: Freud had it right. Freud said, look, there's much more to it than speech: "No mortal can keep a secret.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伊德说对了弗洛伊德说：瞧，话中确实有话“没有人能保守住秘密。

sentences.en: If his lips are silent, he chatters with his fingertips."
sentences.zh: 他的嘴闭上了，他的指尖却在说谎。”

sentences.en: And we all do it no matter how powerful you are.
sentences.zh: 我们都是这样 不管你有多厉害

sentences.en: We all chatter with our fingertips. I'm going to show you Dominique Strauss-Kahn with Obama who's chattering with his fingertips.
sentences.zh: 我们的指尖都会把我们出卖我下面给你们看多米尼克·斯特劳斯-卡恩与奥巴马奥巴马的指尖就出卖了他自己

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now this brings us to our next pattern, which is body language.
sentences.zh: （众人笑）这引出了下一个模式那就是肢体语言

sentences.en: With body language, here's what you've got to do.
sentences.zh: 讲到肢体语言 我们必须

sentences.en: You've really got to just throw your assumptions out the door.
sentences.zh: 把之前的假设统统抛到脑后

sentences.en: Let the science temper your knowledge a little bit.
sentences.zh: 让科学给你长点知识

sentences.en: Because we think liars fidget all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们以为骗子总是坐立不安

sentences.en: Well guess what, they're known to freeze their upper bodies when they're lying.
sentences.zh: 但事实是 他们在说谎时上半身一动也不动

sentences.en: We think liars won't look you in the eyes.
sentences.zh: 我们以为骗子不敢直视你的双眼

sentences.en: Well guess what, they look you in the eyes a little too much just to compensate for that myth.
sentences.zh: 而事实是 他们知道人们会这么想反而会过久地盯着你的眼睛看

sentences.en: We think warmth and smiles convey honesty, sincerity.
sentences.zh: 我们以为寒暄和微笑传达的是真诚

sentences.en: But a trained liespotter can spot a fake smile a mile away.
sentences.zh: 但是一个训练有素的识谎者能够大老远就认出一个假笑

sentences.en: Can you all spot the fake smile here? You can consciously contract the muscles in your cheeks.
sentences.zh: 你们能看出哪个是假笑吗你可以下意识地收紧面部的肌肉

sentences.en: But the real smile's in the eyes, the crow's feet of the eyes.
sentences.zh: 但是真正的微笑是发自眼睛的 从眼角的鱼尾纹就能看出

sentences.en: They cannot be consciously contracted, especially if you overdid the Botox.
sentences.zh: 这些鱼尾纹是挤不出来的如果你打了太多肉毒杆菌素 那就更挤不出来了

sentences.en: Don't overdo the Botox; nobody will think you're honest.
sentences.zh: 别打太多肉毒杆菌素 没人会相信你是诚实的

sentences.en: Now we're going to look at the hot spots.
sentences.zh: 下面我们来找破绽

sentences.en: Can you tell what's happening in a conversation?
sentences.zh: 你们能告诉我一个对话过程中都发生了什么吗

sentences.en: Can you start to find the hot spots to see the discrepancies between someone's words and someone's actions?
sentences.zh: 你可以找出破绽吗能看出某人言行上的不一致吗

sentences.en: Now, I know it seems really obvious, but when you're having a conversation with someone you suspect of deception, attitude is by far the most overlooked but telling of indicators.
sentences.zh: 这似乎很显然但是当你与你怀疑的对象进行对话时你往往忽略了态度这个指示标

sentences.en: An honest person is going to be cooperative.
sentences.zh: 诚实的人会很合作让你感觉他们站在你一边

sentences.en: They're going to show they're on your side.
sentences.zh: 会表现出热情

sentences.en: They're going to be enthusiastic. They're going to be willing and helpful to getting you to the truth.
sentences.zh: 他们会乐意帮助你找出真相

sentences.en: They're going to be willing to brainstorm, name suspects, provide details.
sentences.zh: 他们会帮你找出思路 提出有嫌疑的人提供细节他们会说：“ 啊，

sentences.en: They're going to say, "Hey, maybe it was those guys in payroll that forged those checks."
sentences.zh: 可能是管工资的那些家伙做了这些假支票。”

sentences.en: They're going to be infuriated if they sense they're wrongly accused throughout the entire course of the interview, not just in flashes; they'll be infuriated throughout the entire course of the interview.
sentences.zh: 如果感到自己被诬告他们在整个对话过程中都会非常气愤 而不只是短时间发火他们的怒气会贯穿整个对话过程当你问到一个诚实的人

sentences.en: And if you ask someone honest what should happen to whomever did forge those checks, an honest person is much more likely to recommend strict rather than lenient punishment.
sentences.zh: 应如何惩罚造假支票的人这个诚实的人更可能会建议严惩不贷而不是宽大处理

sentences.en: Now let's say you're having that exact same conversation with someone deceptive.
sentences.zh: 在看看你与一个不诚实的人进行同样的对话会是什么情况

sentences.en: That person may be withdrawn, look down, lower their voice, pause, be kind of herky-jerky.
sentences.zh: 这个人可能会有些疏远往下看 降低音量几字一顿 话不连贯

sentences.en: Ask a deceptive person to tell their story, they're going to pepper it with way too much detail in all kinds of irrelevant places.
sentences.zh: 让不诚实的说自己做过什么他们在一些不着边际的地方透露过多细节

sentences.en: And then they're going to tell their story in strict chronological order.
sentences.zh: 他们接着会严格按照时间顺序陈述

sentences.en: And what a trained interrogator does is they come in and in very subtle ways over the course of several hours, they will ask that person to tell that story backwards, and then they'll watch them squirm, and track which questions produce the highest volume of deceptive tells.
sentences.zh: 一个受过训练的质询者在几个小时的问询过程中旁敲侧击让那个人用倒叙的方式来陈述然后观察他如何说谎并记录嫌疑人在回答哪些问题时音量最大

sentences.en: Why do they do that? Well, we all do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人为什么会这样 这其实是人之常情

sentences.en: We rehearse our words, but we rarely rehearse our gestures.
sentences.zh: 我们会事先想好说什么但很少事先想好做什么样的动作

sentences.en: We say "yes," we shake our heads "no." We tell very convincing stories, we slightly shrug our shoulders.
sentences.zh: 我们说“是” 而我们却在摇头表示“否”我们说的故事非常有说服力 但我们却轻轻地耸了耸肩

sentences.en: We commit terrible crimes, and we smile at the delight in getting away with it.
sentences.zh: 我们犯了严重的罪而在侥幸逃脱时面露微笑

sentences.en: Now, that smile is known in the trade as "duping delight."
sentences.zh: 这种微笑被称为“欺骗的喜悦”

sentences.en: And we're going to see that in several videos moving forward, but we're going to start -- for those of you who don't know him, this is presidential candidate John Edwards who shocked America by fathering a child out of wedlock.
sentences.zh: 我们会在接下来的几个视频中看到现在开始 可能有人不认识他 我先介绍一下他是前总统候选人约翰·爱德华兹他因育有一个私生子而震惊全美

sentences.en: We're going to see him talk about getting a paternity test.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到他谈论进行亲子鉴定的事

sentences.en: See now if you can spot him saying, "yes" while shaking his head "no," slightly shrugging his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 看看你们能否发现他在说“是”的时候 他的头却在摇肩膀在耸

sentences.en: (Video) John Edwards: I'd be happy to participate in one.
sentences.zh: （视频）约翰·爱德华兹：我很乐意去做鉴定

sentences.en: I know that it's not possible that this child could be mine, because of the timing of events.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个孩子不可能是我的因为时间不对

sentences.en: So I know it's not possible. Happy to take a paternity test, and would love to see it happen.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不可能是我的我乐意进行亲子鉴定也很想知道结果

sentences.en: Interviewer: Are you going to do that soon? Is there somebody -- JE: Well, I'm only one side. I'm only one side of the test.
sentences.zh: 记者：你会很快去做鉴定吗 有人...约翰·爱德华兹：我只是鉴定的一方

sentences.en: But I'm happy to participate in one. PM: Okay, those head shakes are much easier to spot once you know to look for them.
sentences.zh: 但是我很乐意进行鉴定帕米拉：好了 只要你注意看就不难发现他在摇头

sentences.en: There are going to be times when someone makes one expression while masking another that just kind of leaks through in a flash.
sentences.zh: 一个人往往会通过一个表情来掩饰另一个表情 而这个表情会闪现出来

sentences.en: Murderers are known to leak sadness. Your new joint venture partner might shake your hand, celebrate, go out to dinner with you and then leak an expression of anger.
sentences.zh: 谋杀者通常会漏出伤感之色你新的合资伙伴可能会跟你握手庆祝 和你去吃饭接着漏出一丝愤怒

sentences.en: And we're not all going to become facial expression experts overnight here, but there's one I can teach you that's very dangerous and it's easy to learn, and that's the expression of contempt.
sentences.zh: 我们不可能一夜之间成为表情专家我下面教你们辨识一个非常危险的表情 这也很容易学会那就是轻蔑的表情

sentences.en: Now with anger, you've got two people on an even playing field.
sentences.zh: 假设两个人势均力敌地竞争

sentences.en: It's still somewhat of a healthy relationship.
sentences.zh: 这是个比较正常的关系

sentences.en: But when anger turns to contempt, you've been dismissed.
sentences.zh: 但是愤怒一旦变成轻蔑你就输了

sentences.en: It's associated with moral superiority. And for that reason, it's very, very hard to recover from.
sentences.zh: 这与道德优越感有关正因如此 人们才很难改正这个行为

sentences.en: Here's what it looks like. It's marked by one lip corner pulled up and in.
sentences.zh: 这样的表情就是轻蔑其标识就是一边的嘴角向上并往里收起

sentences.en: It's the only asymmetrical expression. And in the presence of contempt, whether or not deception follows -- and it doesn't always follow -- look the other way, go the other direction, reconsider the deal,
sentences.zh: 这是唯一一个不对称的表情不论对方是否在说谎也并不总是谎言只要看到对方轻蔑的表情就应该往反方向思考重新考虑这笔交易

sentences.en: say, "No thank you. I'm not coming up for just one more nightcap. Thank you."
sentences.zh: 说：“不用了。谢谢。我来可不是喝酒的。谢谢了。”

sentences.en: Science has surfaced many, many more indicators.
sentences.zh: 科学发现了更多的指示标

sentences.en: We know, for example, we know liars will shift their blink rate, point their feet towards an exit.
sentences.zh: 比如说骗子会改变他们眨眼的频率他们的脚会对着出口

sentences.en: They will take barrier objects and put them between themselves and the person that is interviewing them.
sentences.zh: 他们会拿某样东西挡在质询者和自己之间

sentences.en: They'll alter their vocal tone, often making their vocal tone much lower.
sentences.zh: 他们会改变说话的音调通常是把音调压低许多

sentences.en: Now here's the deal. These behaviors are just behaviors.
sentences.zh: 请注意这些行为都只是行为而已并不是谎言的证明

sentences.en: They're not proof of deception. They're red flags.
sentences.zh: 它们起到的是警示的作用

sentences.en: We're human beings. We make deceptive flailing gestures all over the place all day long.
sentences.zh: 我们都是人我们整天都在做掩盖谎言的动作

sentences.en: They don't mean anything in and of themselves.
sentences.zh: 这些动作本身没有任何意义

sentences.en: But when you see clusters of them, that's your signal.
sentences.zh: 但是如果看到一连串这样的动作 你就要警觉了

sentences.en: Look, listen, probe, ask some hard questions, get out of that very comfortable mode of knowing, walk into curiosity mode, ask more questions, have a little dignity, treat the person you're talking to with rapport.
sentences.zh: 你要观察 倾听 质问 问一些难的问题从心安理得的状态走出来进入好奇模式 多问问题提高点自尊 并尊重对方

sentences.en: Don't try to be like those folks on "Law & Order" and those other TV shows that pummel their subjects into submission.
sentences.zh: 尽量不要像“法律与秩序”一类美剧里的那群人那样对嫌疑人强行逼供

sentences.en: Don't be too aggressive, it doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 不要太咄咄逼人 这是行不通的

sentences.en: Now, we've talked a little bit about how to talk to someone who's lying and how to spot a lie.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了如何与一个说谎的人说话如何辨别一个谎言

sentences.en: And as I promised, we're now going to look at what the truth looks like.
sentences.zh: 刚才说过 我们将看到真实的表情是什么样的

sentences.en: But I'm going to show you two videos, two mothers -- one is lying, one is telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 但我将播放两段视频两位母亲 一位在说谎 一位在说实话

sentences.en: And these were surfaced by researcher David Matsumoto in California.
sentences.zh: 两段视频都是由加利福尼亚的研究者David Matsumoto研究发现的

sentences.en: And I think they're an excellent example of what the truth looks like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这两个视频非常好地说明了什么才是事实

sentences.en: This mother, Diane Downs, shot her kids at close range, drove them to the hospital while they bled all over the car, claimed a scraggy-haired stranger did it.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲 黛安·当丝用枪近距离射中自己的孩子接着开车将他们送往医院他们在车上血流不止她谎称这是一个头发蓬乱的陌生人干的

sentences.en: And you'll see when you see the video, she can't even pretend to be an agonizing mother.
sentences.zh: 在视频中你会看到她假装悲伤都装不出来

sentences.en: What you want to look for here is an incredible discrepancy between horrific events that she describes and her very, very cool demeanor.
sentences.zh: 请你们注意她所讲述的骇人故事与她极为冷静的举止这两者间的强烈对比

sentences.en: And if you look closely, you'll see duping delight throughout this video.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看 你会看到她在视频中流露出欺骗的喜悦（视频）黛安·当丝：每当晚上我闭上双眼

sentences.en: (Video) Diane Downs: At night when I close my eyes, I can see Christie reaching her hand out to me while I'm driving, and the blood just kept coming out of her mouth.
sentences.zh: 我可以看见 克里斯蒂向我伸出手 我一边开着车血不停地从她口里冒出来

sentences.en: And that -- maybe it'll fade too with time -- but I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 也许时间久了我就会淡忘但是 我觉得不可能

sentences.en: That bothers me the most. PM: Now I'm going to show you a video of an actual grieving mother, Erin Runnion,
sentences.zh: 这让我寝食难安现在我给你们看另一个视频这是一位真正悲伤的母亲 艾琳·兰尼恩

sentences.en: confronting her daughter's murderer and torturer in court.
sentences.zh: 这是她在法庭上与虐杀自己女儿的凶手对质的情形

sentences.en: Here you're going to see no false emotion, just the authentic expression of a mother's agony.
sentences.zh: 你完全看不到任何虚假的情绪这是一位心痛欲绝的母亲真实的哭斥

sentences.en: (Video) Erin Runnion: I wrote this statement on the third anniversary of the night you took my baby, and you hurt her, and you crushed her, you terrified her until her heart stopped.
sentences.zh: （视频）艾琳·兰尼恩：在你带走我宝贝的三年后的同一天我写下了这段话你伤害了她把她打得体无完肤害她惊恐万状 直到她心脏停止了跳动

sentences.en: And she fought, and I know she fought you.
sentences.zh: 她反抗了 我知道她反抗了

sentences.en: But I know she looked at you with those amazing brown eyes, and you still wanted to kill her.
sentences.zh: 我也知道她用她那双美丽的棕色眼睛看着你而你还是对她痛下杀手

sentences.en: And I don't understand it, and I never will.
sentences.zh: 我不能理解

sentences.en: PM: Okay, there's no doubting the veracity of those emotions.
sentences.zh: 永远都不能理解帕米拉：好了 毫无疑问 这些情绪都是真的

sentences.en: Now the technology around what the truth looks like is progressing on, the science of it.
sentences.zh: 现在的测谎技术正在日新月异地发展

sentences.en: We know, for example, that we now have specialized eye trackers and infrared brain scans, MRI's that can decode the signals that our bodies send out when we're trying to be deceptive.
sentences.zh: 比如说我们有专门的眼球追踪仪 红外线脑部扫描还有能够破解我们说谎时身体发射信号的核磁共振成像技术

sentences.en: And these technologies are going to be marketed to all of us as panaceas for deceit, and they will prove incredibly useful some day.
sentences.zh: 这些技术得到广泛推广成了测谎的保障有朝一日 这些技术会发挥意想不到的作用

sentences.en: But you've got to ask yourself in the meantime: Who do you want on your side of the meeting, someone who's trained in getting to the truth or some guy who's going to drag a 400-pound electroencephalogram through the door?
sentences.zh: 但与此同时 你们必须扪心自问在开会时你希望来的是一位训练有素的测谎专家呢还是看着一个拖着重达400磅脑电图仪的家伙从门外走进来

sentences.en: Liespotters rely on human tools. They know, as someone once said, "Character's who you are in the dark."
sentences.zh: 识谎者依赖的是人性的工具有人曾说 他们知道“人格就是黑暗中的人类本性”

sentences.en: And what's kind of interesting is that today, we have so little darkness.
sentences.zh: 有意思的是如今我们的黑暗太少了

sentences.en: Our world is lit up 24 hours a day. It's transparent with blogs and social networks broadcasting the buzz of a whole new generation of people that have made a choice to live their lives in public.
sentences.zh: 我们的世界全天24个小时都是亮堂堂的博客和社交网站把新一代人的声音广播出去这代人选择活在公众的目光之下世界都是透明的了

sentences.en: It's a much more noisy world. So one challenge we have is to remember, oversharing, that's not honesty.
sentences.zh: 世界现在更加嘈杂因此我们必须记住一点过度分享不等于诚实

sentences.en: Our manic tweeting and texting can blind us to the fact that the subtleties of human decency -- character integrity -- that's still what matters, that's always what's going to matter.
sentences.zh: 疯狂地发微博 发短信会让我们忽视一个事实即人类的道德正义仍然很重要 无论是现在还是将来

sentences.en: So in this much noisier world, it might make sense for us to be just a little bit more explicit about our moral code.
sentences.zh: 在这样一个嘈杂的世界里我们对道德准则稍微较真儿一点还是有道理的

sentences.en: When you combine the science of recognizing deception with the art of looking, listening, you exempt yourself from collaborating in a lie.
sentences.zh: 当你把观察和倾听的艺术与识谎的科学结合起来你就不会上当受骗

sentences.en: You start up that path of being just a little bit more explicit, because you signal to everyone around you, you say, "Hey, my world, our world, it's going to be an honest one.
sentences.zh: 你可以从表明自己懂得识谎做起因为你在对周围所有人发出信号你在说：“ 哎，我的世界，我们的世界，会是一个诚实的世界。

sentences.en: My world is going to be one where truth is strengthened and falsehood is recognized and marginalized."
sentences.zh: 在我的世界中，真相得到捍卫，虚假被识破并消灭。”

sentences.en: And when you do that, the ground around you starts to shift just a little bit.
sentences.zh: 这么做能让你脚下的世界一点一点地发生改变

sentences.en: And that's the truth. Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 这可一点不假 感谢大家（众人鼓掌）
